strengths: Correctly identifies pericyte/mural anchor using TBX18, NOTCH3, PDGFRB, RGS5, P2RY14
Recognizes the absence of contractile VSMC markers ACTA2, MYH11, TAGLN, CNN1
Acknowledges the VLMC/perivascular fibroblast-like ECM component without losing the mural identity
weaknesses: Top1 label is unmapped/broad rather than a single ontology class
Includes VSMC and VLMC as candidate types even though VSMC is not supported by contractile markers
Pericyte-VLMC state phrasing suggests mixture without selecting a single primary identity

strengths: Provides an exact valid ontology ID for the mural lineage
Consistent with canonical mural markers NOTCH3, PDGFRB, RGS5
Top-k includes the more specific pericyte and brain pericyte labels
weaknesses: Top1 mural cell is an ancestor of the supported pericyte identity
Does not explicitly address the VLMC/perivascular fibroblast-like ECM signal
Candidate scores place pericyte/brain pericyte above mural cell, so the top1 label is less specific than the evidence supports

strengths: Uses RGS5, NOTCH3, PDGFRB, and TBX18 to support a mural/pericyte identity
Acknowledges the lack of contractile VSMC markers
weaknesses: Composite top1 label is not a single ontology-valid cell type
VSMC component is non-hierarchical and unsupported by the original markers
VLMC candidate is a non-hierarchical alternative rather than a supported primary

supporting: Canonical pericyte/mural markers TBX18, NOTCH3, PDGFRB, RGS5, P2RY14, GJC1, ATP1A2 support pericyte identity (PMID 23675535; PMID 38685679).
Hierarchical refinement from mural cell (CL:0008034) to pericyte (CL:0000669) is supported by RGS5/PDGFRB/NOTCH3/P2RY14 and does not require VSMC contractile markers.
ECM/basement-membrane program genes COL4A3, COL4A4, NID1, LAMA2, LAMA4, and FN1 are consistent with pericyte vascular support biology (PMID 31506348).
conflicting: No ACTA2, MYH11, TAGLN, or CNN1 expression, so vascular associated smooth muscle cell (CL:0000359) is not a supported non-hierarchical branch.
VLMC/perivascular fibroblast-like genes EBF1, ITIH5, CFH, LEF1, DCN, and FBLN1 introduce an ECM/fibroblast-like secondary signal but do not overturn the dominant pericyte/mural anchor.
enrichment_or_literature: Literature retrieval for the cluster returned pericyte/mural-supporting PMIDs (23675535, 34552146, 38685679).
The observed ECM/collagen/laminin gene pattern is consistent with pericyte vascular support function.
